build_CoTracker2_model: build a CoTracker2 model with configurable window length, stride, and virtual tracks for video point tracking
run_CoTracker2_forward: run the CoTracker2 forward pass to predict tracked coordinates and visibility for point queries in a video
run_EfficientUpdateFormer_forward: run the EfficientUpdateFormer forward pass to update track estimates using time and space attention blocks
review_CoTracker2_forward_window: review the CoTracker2 forward_window method which iteratively refines coordinate predictions using correlation features and a transformer
refactor_CrossAttnBlock: refactor the CrossAttnBlock class to modify cross-attention behavior between point tokens and virtual track tokens
